items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: it started getting more sophisticated and more educated with the like Fletcher Henderson

ctx.x: They had, from the ‘20s, well you can go back to say 1910 and start coming up and it started changing there, and then it started getting more sophisticated and more educated with the like Fletcher Henderson, and that came along and then all of a sudden bebop came out and that came for a while and so forth and then another form came, and it’s the same — to me it’s the same as food. I always say food and music are very similar. Food is for nourishment of your body, and music is for nourishment of your mind. Now if…
That’s great. At 8:30 in the morning.
